# SCP-096 Abilities
This page describes the entity's available activated abilities and the unique mechanics associated with it.
[textlink="General information about the Shy Guy" link="Scp096About"]
## Ability "Let Out a Pitiful Scream"
Activating this ability creates a powerful anomalous resonance that destroys nearby structures with a sonic wave. This ability only works inside the containment chamber. Use it to destroy the chamber.
[textlink="More information about escape methods" link="Scp096ContainmentBreach"]
## Ability "Rip the Skin off Your Face"
Activating this ability damages your face and splatters your blood everywhere. Using the ability 5 times in a row will critically damage your face, putting you into the "Flayed Face" state.
[textlink="More information about states" link="Scp096States"]
[bold]To activate this ability, you must stand still without moving for a couple of seconds until the progress bar above your head is complete.[/bold]
This ability has a long cooldown!
## Ability "Sit Down"
Activating this ability puts you into the "Sitting" state. The entity's appearance changes, and it loses the ability to move. In this state, the Shy Guy sheds tears more often.
Overall, this state has no practical use. You can enter it at any time.
## Safe Period Mechanic
During the first 15 minutes of the round, you cannot use the "Rip the Skin off Your Face" ability.
This mechanic restricts SCP entities at the start of the round, giving personnel time to prepare for the shift.
## Vision Mechanic
The game has a unique system that checks whether each character is visible to every other character.
[bold]If you and another person look each other in the face, you will enter the "Pre-Rage" state and then the "Rage" state.[/bold] The person who saw you will become a valid target whom you can easily eliminate.
